property_summary: For any target address and value, the reference contract C always increments its depositsCount when its fallback is invoked by a failing external call target receiving funds (i.e., the low-level call to a callee that reverts still results in the reference's state change via the fallback when funds are sent), whereas the mutant that requires success will revert and thus not allow the state change for some adversarial callee that reverts on receive.
change_summary: Perform the call and check the returned success boolean, reverting on failure, which changes whether state (balances) is affected when the external call fails silently in the original.
